block_summary:
**Triage Summary:**

Six CRITICAL vulnerabilities across two packages require immediate remediation. CVE-2024-38475 affects all Apache2 components (apache2, apache2-bin, apache2-data, apache2-utils) at version 2.4.54-1~deb11u1 with perfect exploit probability (EPSS 1.000) and active exploitation in the wild (KEV=yes); CVE-2023-38545 affects curl/libcurl at version 7.74.0-1.3+deb11u3 with high exploit likelihood (EPSS 0.785). Both vulnerabilities have available fixes. 

**Recommended Action:** Approve this build only if immediate patching is scheduled within 24 hours. Prioritize Apache2 upgrade first due to active exploitation risk, then update curl/libcurl. If patching cannot be expedited, block the build to prevent deploying known-exploited vulnerabilities into production.
review_summary:
**Triage Summary:**

Twenty findings across four core packages (Apache2, glibc, systemd, nghttp2) are all HIGH/CRITICAL severity with fixes available and none flagged as actively exploited (KEV). The Apache2 suite has four CRITICAL CVEs (CVE-2023-25690) plus four HIGH CVEs (CVE-2024-27316) affecting all related binaries; glibc has eight HIGH findings split between two CVEs; systemd/udev and nghttp2 each have two-three HIGH findings. All vulnerabilities have confirmed patches, making this a straightforward dependency upgrade scenario rather than a risk acceptance decision.

**Recommended Action:** Approve the build contingent on scheduling immediate patching of Apache2 (2.4.54 → latest), glibc (2.31 → latest), and systemd (247.3 → latest) within your next maintenance window. Document the deferral and set a hard deadline; do not merge without a follow-up ticket tracking the upgrades.
